title: Ave maris stella (Martini)
desc: Johannes Martini, Ave maris stella. 4 voices (Superius, Contra, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Mar2006); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
